description: Cavites souterraines 76 2023 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de la Seine Maritime. The dataset presents the inventory of underground cavities in Seine-Maritime (WGS 1984 Web Mercator). The cavities are of natural or anthropogenic origin and are sorted by type. Date of data: 2023. Data source: Georisks Underground cavities can affect soil stability. Coverage: Département de la Seine Maritime. The portal shows the English title as "Underground cavities 76 2023" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département de la Seine Maritime. Its keywords include geospatial, marnieres, stabilite, cavites-souterraines, carrieres, cavites. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WEB PAGE. The listing shows 2024-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
